'''Andrew Echnoz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 1999 Boca Raton tournament]] on 21 November 1999 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Docking Bay Blitz]], according to Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d121">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-23-boca-raton-florida-11-21-99d121/ boca-raton-florida-11-21-99], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 23 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-23-boca-raton-florida-11-21-99d121/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
